dedupe_keys.name: hydrouq waterborne hazard structural simulation platform

description: HydroUQ is an open-source desktop application from NHERI SimCenter for simulating structural response to tsunamis and storm surges with uncertainty quantification. Users can configure far-shore wave forcing, near-shore water evolution, building or geotechnical models and uncertainty methods. The workflow links event, simulation, engineering-demand and response stages, and outputs pressures, velocities, loads and probabilistic structural responses for a selected site and event. Geographic coverage is a user-defined project site, while temporal resolution follows the wave and structure simulations. The repository licence states BSD-3-Clause, although a README badge says BSD-2-Clause; the actual licence file takes precedence. A limitation is that results depend on selected hazard models and building parameters, and advanced coupled runs need substantial external software. HydroUQ supports coastal critical-facility and building resilience analysis. The catalogue's model-openfoam is one distinct CFD component that HydroUQ can use. No installer, wave data or example was downloaded.
